verses.text: "Sing a funeral song for the princes of Israel.
Say: 'What a lioness your mother was among the lions! She lay among the young lions and raised her cubs.
She raised one of her cubs, and he became a strong young lion. He learned to tear apart his prey, and he ate people.
The nations heard about him, and he was caught in their pit. They led him with hooks to the land of Egypt.
When she saw that her hope was gone and nothing had come of her waiting, she took another of her cubs and made him a strong young lion.
He prowled among the lions and became a strong young lion. He learned to tear apart his prey, and he ate people.
He broke down their fortresses and destroyed their towns. The land and everyone in it were terrified by the sound of his roaring.
Then the nations from the surrounding regions came against him. They spread their net over him, and he was caught in their pit.
They put him in a cage with hooks and brought him to the king of Babylon. They put him in prison, so that his roar was no longer heard on the mountains of Israel.
Your mother was like a vine in your vineyard, planted by the water. It was full of fruit and branches because there was plenty of water.
Its branches were strong, fit for a ruler's scepter. It grew tall among the thick branches. It stood out because of its height and its many branches.
But it was pulled up in fury and thrown to the ground. The east wind dried up its fruit. Its strong branches were broken off and withered, and fire burned them up.
Now it is planted in the desert, in a dry and thirsty land.
Fire has spread from one of its main branches and burned up its fruit. No strong branch is left on it, fit for a ruler's scepter.' This is a funeral song, and it will be used as a funeral song."
